def is_nested(string):
    max_depth = 0
    current_depth = 0
    
    for bracket in string:
        if bracket == '[':
            current_depth += 1
            max_depth = max(max_depth, current_depth)
        elif bracket == ']':
            current_depth -= 1
            if current_depth < 0:
                return False  # Unmatched closing bracket
        
        if current_depth == 0 and max_depth >= 2:
            break
    
    return max_depth >= 2 and current_depth == 0

# Test cases
print(is_nested('[[]]'))       # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))   # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # ➞ False

CONFIDENCE: 95
